methods.comment:
* Gets whether the request was a result of a server-side redirect. * *

* This method should only be called if * {@link WebViewFeature#isFeatureSupported(String)} * returns true for {@link WebViewFeature#WEB_RESOURCE_REQUEST_IS_REDIRECT}. * * @return whether the request was a result of a server-side redirect.
